baseline_models.focus_anchor: The severe cry for extraction is answered by the final denial of any helper.
baseline_models.mechanism: The cry root carries distress-call, appeal for relief, and answering relief as adjacent possibilities. The closing denial of a helper cancels the expected completion of that call, so the ayah stages a rescue circuit whose answer-channel is now closed.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes an elevated, severe voice and makes the scene audibly catastrophic.
The branch makes the cry literally a call for relief and supplies the first half of the rescue circuit.
The branch supplies answering aid as the cry's latent completion, which the ayah's ending blocks.
The branch contributes aid that makes one prevail and, under explicit negation, closes the response channel.

changed_reading.before: They scream in distress and happen to have no helper.
changed_reading.after: Their scream itself projects an answering rescue, but the final clause deliberately severs that lexical and causal completion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Two occurrences of intended action surround the demand for sound action unlike the former action.
baseline_models.mechanism: The requested future keeps the same faculty of intentional action while substituting its quality and product. The plea is therefore not merely for relocation; it asks to rerun agency and replace its former output with a fitting one.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes intentional action to both the promised future and admitted past, holding agency constant across the proposed rerun.
The branch contributes repair opposed to corruption and specifies the new action's desired quality.
The branch contributes fitness for a purpose and lets the promise mean action newly fitted to its proper occasion.
The branch contributes alteration or replacement and turns difference into a proposed exchange of outputs.
The branch locates the former action in elapsed time and supplies the before-side of the requested temporal reset.

changed_reading.before: They promise vaguely to behave better if released.
changed_reading.after: They request a second run of the same human agency with its prior product replaced by action fitted to the right purpose.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The granted span contains enough room for whoever would recollect, with recollection named twice.
baseline_models.mechanism: Life-extension supplies duration, while the habitation and repair branch makes the span an inhabited, maintained arena. The repeated recollection root distinguishes an available reminder-space from the person's actual act of bringing warning back to mind.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes extended life-time and establishes that an adequate duration was granted.
The branch contributes habitation and repair, functioning as a material model for life as usable reminder-space.
The branch contributes inward recovery after forgetfulness and identifies the use that the granted span enabled.
The branch contributes an external reminder that restores presence, joining allotted time to warning.

changed_reading.before: They were simply old enough to know better.
changed_reading.after: Their lifespan was an inhabited and maintained opportunity in which warning could be restored to active memory.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The arrival of a warner is followed immediately by the command to taste.
baseline_models.mechanism: Warning first arrives as information meant to awaken caution. The command to taste reverses distance: what was report and possibility becomes direct, embodied trial, after which aid is denied.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes actual arrival and marks warning as an event that reached them rather than a remote possibility.
The branch contributes frightening notice intended to awaken caution before danger arrives.
The branch contributes experiential trial and converts previously announced consequence into bodily knowledge.

changed_reading.before: A warning was given, ignored, and punishment followed.
changed_reading.after: The ayah moves from danger known by arriving report to the same danger known by irreversible experience.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The speakers address their Lord, ask to be brought out, and promise repaired action.
baseline_models.mechanism: Across both mapped targets of the address root, mastery is joined to gradual repair, feeding, and growth. Together with emergence from hiddenness and action opposed to corruption, the appeal can be heard as a request that the formative Lord educate and grow them over again, not only move them spatially.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes gradual repair, nurture, and completion as the formative function invoked by the address.
The split target contributes feeding and growth, extending the appeal from governance to renewed development.
The branch contributes bringing something out of hiddenness or ignorance and makes extraction potentially educative.
The branch contributes repair against corruption as the promised result of renewed formation.

changed_reading.before: They ask the sovereign Lord for a change of location.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they appeal to formative lordship for a second education and growth into repaired action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence makes bad action appear attractive and then be seen as good. This revises the proposed action-swap: changing the output requires corrected valuation, because the old evaluator could label another bad act sound.

activation_trace.role: Intentional action remains the focus faculty whose promised future quality is under question.
Repair opposed to corruption is the claimed new standard that distorted evaluation may fail to identify.
Displayed attractiveness supplies the mechanism by which an act's apparent value can diverge from its quality.
Literal badness supplies the concealed quality beneath the attractive presentation.
The repeated intentional-action root ties the perceptual distortion directly to the same faculty invoked in the focus promise.
The opposition of good to bad becomes a mistaken perception and destabilizes the speakers' proposed classification.

structural_cues: In 35:8 beautification precedes seeing, while the object remains bad action.
The focus promises a new quality of action but does not state a new faculty of judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prior mismatch between an act's bad quality and its perceived goodness; I infer that relocation alone need not cure that evaluator. A live alternative is that present recognition of failure already signals genuine perceptual correction.

changed_reading.before: A sincere choice to perform different acts would be enough.
changed_reading.after: The promise is epistemically unstable unless the faculty that once saw bad work as good is itself changed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dead land is made alive and named as a model of rising. The requested extraction is therefore denied despite demonstrated power to reverse death, shifting the focus from physical impossibility to a closed moral and temporal permission.

activation_trace.role: Emergence out of a containing state is the requested transition whose availability must be explained.
Loss of life and power supplies the apparently terminal condition that the context reverses.
Rain-given life to land provides the material reversal that demonstrates effective reanimation.
Reviving the dead names the material sequence as a model of rising and transfers it toward the focus request.

structural_cues: 35:9 gives a causal sequence from dead land through enlivening to rising.
The focus asks the same sovereign addressee for emergence but receives a command to remain with the consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies demonstrated reversal of death and a later denied exit; I infer that the denial concerns permission and timing rather than deficient power. The live alternative is that 35:9 establishes resurrection generally without addressing reprieve after judgment.

changed_reading.before: They cannot be extracted because their condition is physically final.
changed_reading.after: Extraction is within demonstrated power, but the opportunity for extraction into renewed agency is judicially closed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, good speech rises in immediate relation to sound action that raises it. The focus reverses the order: a maximally loud utterance promises sound action only after action is no longer available, so words cannot serve as a substitute for their missing partner.

activation_trace.role: The loud voice supplies speech at maximum intensity while leaving its practical efficacy unresolved.
Literal upward movement gives good speech a trajectory that is not generated by loudness.
Meaningful speech supplies the verbal element whose relation to enacted work is being tested.
Intentional action repeats the focus root and supplies the absent practical partner of the later cry.
Repairing action repeats the exact desired quality and locates it beside good speech before the focus crisis.
Raising supplies the functional linkage by which action and speech become effective together.

structural_cues: 35:10 places good speech and sound action in one ascending construction.
35:37 places the loud plea before only a future promise of action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ascending speech, sound action, and an ambiguous raising relation; I infer that enacted action validates or carries speech. A materially live alternative is that the pronoun makes good speech raise action rather than action raise speech, but either direction preserves their coupling.

changed_reading.before: The plea fails because it is not heard or is insufficiently urgent.
changed_reading.after: The plea is loud but belatedly detached from the enacted work that could have made its words effective.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier account places every extension and decrement of a life in an obligating record. The focus question therefore audits a measured allotment: enough duration was not accidental background but a finite budget whose use is now evidence.

activation_trace.role: Extended life supplies the focus allotment that is retrospectively questioned.
Repeated extension and lifespan language makes duration an explicitly administered quantity.
Loss of part of a thing supplies the decrement side of the measured life account.
Recorded establishment that entails a determination turns duration into an auditable allotment rather than vague longevity.

structural_cues: 35:11 coordinates lengthening, shortening, and a record in one sentence.
35:37 asks whether the granted duration reached the threshold needed for recollection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies administered extension, decrement, and record; I infer a spent temporal budget whose adequacy bears on responsibility. The alternative is that the record asserts knowledge and order without implying a moral quota of time.

changed_reading.before: Long life is merely circumstantial evidence that they had chances.
changed_reading.after: The granted span is a measured and recorded resource whose sufficient duration is itself part of the charge.

context_deltas.mechanism: A loaded caller cannot have the load carried even by kin, and purification returns to the same self. This revises the denial of a helper into a nontransferability rule: neither burden nor the repairing action the speakers now promise can be delegated after the fact.

activation_trace.role: Denied aid supplies the focus endpoint whose scope is sharpened from absent rescue to unavailable transfer.
Bearing a moral trust or burden supplies the load that another cannot assume.
Kinship supplies the strongest ordinary social transfer channel and the text explicitly leaves it ineffective.
Purification and soundness supply the repairing process that is indexed back to its own agent.
The thing's own self or identity fixes the beneficiary and bearer of purification to the same person.

structural_cues: 35:18 negates transfer first generally and then even under kinship.
Its purification clause repeats the reflexive beneficiary before the focus asks for a helper.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed burden-transfer and self-returning purification; I infer that the promised repair cannot now be outsourced to a rescuer. The live alternative is that the focus helper concerns extraction only, not transfer of responsibility.

changed_reading.before: No ally is willing or able to pull them out.
changed_reading.after: The needed moral work and its burden are constitutively nontransferable, so external extraction cannot perform the self-work they deferred.

context_deltas.mechanism: The run of seeing, shade and heat, life and death, and effective hearing distinguishes receptivity before consequence. In the focus, former recipients become loud sound-producers and embodied tasters: sensory agency intensifies only after hearing-as-response is no longer available.

activation_trace.role: Severe audible crying makes the judged subjects producers of a sound they now need answered.
Experiential tasting makes consequence bodily certain after earlier mediated warning.
Insight of the heart supplies the receptive seeing contrasted with blindness in the context sequence.
Protective shade supplies one side of the bodily contrast that later becomes experienced consequence.
Heat opposed to coolness supplies the adverse bodily pole toward which the focus taste points.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the response-capacity that mere acoustic reception lacks.
Loss of life and power supplies the context's image for nonresponsive reception.
Repeated warning supplies the earlier sound whose purpose was responsive caution rather than later screaming.

structural_cues: 35:19-22 builds paired sensory and vital inequalities before 35:23-24 repeats the warner.
35:37 moves from their loud sound to commanded bodily experience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sensory opposition sequence and later crying and tasting; I infer a reversal from failed receptivity to compulsory sensation. The alternative is that the earlier living/dead and hearing language addresses a broader audience rather than these exact speakers.

changed_reading.before: The cry and tasting are separate dramatic details.
changed_reading.after: They complete a sensory reversal: those who did not hear responsively now make unheard sound and know through unavoidable bodily experience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context models faithful practice as commerce that does not fail and as labor paid fully. Because the focus action root also carries a wage branch, the request to work after tasting consequence can be read as an attempt to enter a settled exchange after its performance period has closed.

activation_trace.role: The wage of labor supplies a latent compensation frame inside the speakers' request to work.
Commerce seeking gain supplies the exchange model for practices performed during the available term.
Market stagnation ending in loss supplies the failure explicitly denied of the earlier commerce.
Full completion without deficit supplies settlement of what was actually performed.
Compensation for work supplies the payable return that cannot be generated by a post-settlement promise.

structural_cues: 35:29-30 moves from ongoing practices to nonfailing commerce and then full payment.
The focus offers future work only after the command to experience the result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies commerce, completed payment, and a focus branch for wages; I infer a closed performance and settlement window. The live alternative is that commerce is only an encouragement image and should not be pressed into a literal post-judgment ledger.

changed_reading.before: They merely request one more chance to accumulate good deeds.
changed_reading.after: They attempt to tender future labor after the exchange has reached settlement, when a promise is no longer a payable performance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding contrast gives one group settled residence without fatigue and the other a state with neither completed death nor lessening. The focus cry from within that state asks for an exit through thresholds the context has just declared unavailable.

activation_trace.role: Emergence outside a place or condition supplies the requested threshold-crossing.
Settling into a place supplies the positive mode of arrival against which the focus confinement is read.
Residence and belonging to a dwelling supply the stable spatial frame immediately before the punitive scene.
Remaining in a place supplies permanence to the favorable dwelling and sharpens the opposing permanence.
Completion and coming to an end supply the terminal passage explicitly withheld.
Loss of life supplies one possible exit from experience, and the syntax denies it.
Lightening a load supplies the lesser threshold of attenuation, which is also denied.

structural_cues: 35:35 names settled residence twice through dwelling and permanence.
35:36 denies both ending and attenuation immediately before the cry in 35:37.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent favorable residence, denied death, and denied lessening; I infer that the requested exit seeks unavailable terminal or attenuating thresholds, not just a door. The alternative is a simpler contrast of destinies without a technical spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They ask to leave a painful location.
changed_reading.after: They inhabit an anti-dwelling whose ordinary exits, ending and attenuation, have already been closed before they ask to cross out.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later challenge strips invoked partners of productive share, then describes wrongdoers promising one another only deception. The focus denial of a helper thus closes not only individual aid but a whole counterfeit network of reciprocal assurances.

activation_trace.role: Denied aid supplies the collapsed endpoint of the social and cultic rescue network.
Participation and shared claim supply the purported network whose productive share is challenged.
Withholding what is due identifies the reciprocal promisers with the same class denied a helper in the focus.
Parts of a group acting toward other parts supplies the reciprocal social topology of the promises.
A glittering but unstable deception supplies the actual content of the apparent mutual support.

structural_cues: 35:40 first interrogates the partners' creative share and then gives a reciprocal promise among wrongdoers.
The focus ends with a partitive negation that excludes any helper for that same class.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unproductive partners and reciprocal deceptive assurances; I infer that the focus helper includes the collapse of that network at consequence. The alternative is that 35:40 targets cultic claims and worldly deception without specifying attempted aid in the focus scene.

changed_reading.before: Each wrongdoer simply finds no rescuer.
changed_reading.after: A previously imagined system of shared claims and mutual promises is exposed as nonproductive deception precisely when rescue is demanded.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later scene records a maximal oath that the arrival of a warner would produce greater guidance, followed by the opposite result when the warner actually arrives. The focus promise has the same counterfactual form, so it is not untested sincerity but a type of claim already disproved by an earlier arrival-event.

activation_trace.role: Proposed alteration supplies the focus claim that a changed condition would yield changed conduct.
A formally distributed oath supplies prior high-intensity assurance, stronger than a bare promise.
Exertion to the limit under difficulty intensifies the oath and removes lack of verbal commitment as an explanation.
The oath branch confirms that the claimed future response was solemnly guaranteed.
Repeated actual arrival supplies both the condition proposed in advance and the later test of that proposal.
The warning intended to awaken caution is the promised trigger whose real arrival fails to produce the claimed response.
Withdrawal and distancing supply the observed result opposite to promised guidance.

structural_cues: 35:42 repeats arrival and warning on both sides of a when/then test.
Its observed result reverses the sworn prediction, while 35:37 offers another condition-dependent prediction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prior counterfactual assurance and its failed empirical test; I infer that it functions as evidence against the later extraction-conditioned promise. A live alternative is that the oath-makers and the focus speakers need not be extensionally identical, so the relation may be typological rather than biographical.

changed_reading.before: The speakers' promise may be sincere but comes too late.
changed_reading.after: The promise repeats a counterfactual behavioral forecast whose earlier, stronger version was tested by a warner's arrival and produced the reverse.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later declaration denies both replacement and transformation in the running pattern. This weakens the live possibility inside the focus action-swap: after consequence arrives, proposed other action cannot be inserted as a substitute that converts the already produced outcome.

activation_trace.role: Replacement and alteration supply the speakers' proposed exchange of future action for former action.
A running, followed path supplies the stable process within which outcome follows conduct.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the exact substitution that the context negates.
A thing changing out of its state supplies the transformation that the parallel negation also excludes.

structural_cues: 35:43 uses parallel absolute negations for substitution and transformation.
35:37 asks to replace the former action only after the command to experience its result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a proposed action replacement and a later invariant pattern; I infer that the invariant blocks retroactive substitution after outcome, not all change during life. The alternative is that 35:43 concerns the general historical pattern rather than the admissibility of this particular plea.

changed_reading.before: Different future action could still replace the moral effect of former action if release were granted.
changed_reading.after: Once the process has reached consequence, promised other action cannot be posted as a substitute or conversion of the settled outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final context says immediate taking for what people earned would leave no creature, but instead they are delayed to a named term that eventually arrives. This revises the focus lifespan from neutral duration into forborne enforcement: the long interval was the postponement they now ask to receive again.

activation_trace.role: Extended life supplies the interval whose moral character is revised from mere duration to granted delay.
Taking to account for wrongdoing supplies the enforcement that could have occurred immediately.
Acquiring a result through one's pursuit supplies the causal basis for taking and preserves responsibility during delay.
Leaving or relinquishing supplies the counterfactual total removal that immediate enforcement would produce.
Deferral to a later time supplies the actual relation between earned conduct and postponed taking.
A fixed temporal limit supplies the boundary beyond which postponement is not renewed.
Actual arrival turns the named limit from future allowance into present closure.

structural_cues: 35:45 contrasts immediate taking with deliberate delay and repeats the named term around its arrival.
35:37 retrospectively identifies the already granted lifetime as sufficient for recollection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies earned conduct, withheld immediate enforcement, deferral, and term-arrival; I infer that the focus lifespan is the concrete form of forbearance. The alternative is that length of life and communal delay are related but not identical grants.

changed_reading.before: They ask for an additional lifespan after an ordinary lifespan proved insufficient.
changed_reading.after: They ask to renew the very postponement already embodied in their adequate lifespan after its fixed term has arrived.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers a rain-and-fruit mechanism into moral agency. It remains anchored by the same extraction root, the request for other action, and the context's extracted differentiated fruit. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for requested recultivation, not as a lexical equation between people and produce.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The request to be brought out for action unlike the former action can be modeled as asking to emerge again with a different yield.

activation_trace.role: Emergence from a containing state anchors the requested second production cycle.
Alteration and replacement supply the desired difference in the new yield.
Delivery downward supplies the initiating input of the cultivation mechanism.
Water delivered by irrigation supplies the material means through which a new output is produced.
The repeated emergence root directly links contextual production to the requested emergence in the focus.
Produced benefit supplies the outcome-side of the analogy for changed action.
Taking on a new coloration supplies visible differentiation of the extracted yield.

changed_reading.before: Extraction would merely restore the same agents to a place where they could choose again.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they ask to be recultivated and brought out as a newly differentiated yield whose action-benefit differs from the first crop.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps cosmic holding and displacement onto a personal plea for exit. It remains anchored in the focus extraction and denied helper, while 35:41 supplies holding, movement from state, and exhaustive negation of another holder. Downstream prose should mark it as a force-relation analogy, not claim that the focus explicitly describes cosmic mechanics.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The demanded extraction would require a counterforce to the sovereignly maintained state, but the focus denies any helper.

activation_trace.role: Movement outside a maintained condition supplies the displacement the speakers demand.
Denied aid removes any agent that could supply countervailing force.
Holding and confinement supply the maintaining force against displacement.
Departure from place or state supplies the exact type of transition the holding prevents.
Exhaustive negation removes every alternative holder and reinforces the focus's denial of any helper.

changed_reading.before: No social ally can arrange their release.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, release would require an impossible counterforce against the maintained state, and exhaustive negation removes such a force-provider.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a concrete time-and-place branch of wrongdoing against a request explicitly labeled sound. It remains tightly anchored to the focus sequence: sound action is proposed only after warning, allotted time, and commanded experience. Downstream prose should say the request is temporally misplaced, not that sound action itself becomes wrongdoing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The proposed sound action is offered in the wrong temporal slot, after the action window has closed.

activation_trace.role: Fitness for a purpose supplies the claimed propriety of the proposed action and raises the question of fitness to its time.
Replacement supplies the attempted insertion of a new act where the old act's consequence now stands.
The already extended span supplies the proper earlier interval in which sound action could have occurred.
Experienced consequence marks the later phase in which the proposed act is now offered.
Putting something outside its proper time or place supplies the temporal diagnosis of the otherwise sound proposal.

changed_reading.before: The proposed action is good but merely unavailable.
changed_reading.after: The proposal's content is sound, yet its post-consequence placement repeats the disorder of putting a thing outside its proper time.

strongest_changes: The action promise becomes doubtful because the surah has already shown bad work being perceived as good.
Demonstrated revival makes the denied extraction a closure of permission and timing, not a lack of power.
Burden and purification are nontransferable, so a helper cannot perform the deferred self-work.
A prior maximal oath about responding to a warner was tested by arrival and produced the opposite response.
The adequate lifespan becomes both a measured allotment and a period of deferred taking whose fixed term has arrived.
Replacement and transformation remain live descriptions of the plea but are unavailable as retroactive operations after consequence.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah is unusually dense in reversals: warning becomes tasting, failed reception becomes loud production of sound, an inhabited span becomes evidence, a promised action-swap meets a no-substitution pattern, and the cry lexically contains the rescue-response that the ending removes. Context also activated material, commercial, social, spatial, and formative mechanisms without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The formative recreation model depends on a split-root growth target and should remain exploratory rather than control the reading.
The direction of the raising relation between good speech and sound action in 35:10 remains grammatically live in more than one way.
The prior oath-makers may be typologically rather than individually identical with the focus speakers.
The cultivation, commerce, and cosmic-force models are coherent analogies, but their cross-domain arrows are reader-supplied.
It remains possible to read the denied helper narrowly as failed extraction rather than as burden, speech, exchange, and social-network closure together.
